narrative_idea_gen: Told entirely through one woman's increasingly unhinged incident reports, HR complaint forms, and voice-to-text messages accidentally sent to her mother, *Peristalsis* follows municipal shame-processing engineers Dagne and Ruutu as they're dispatched into the Underbowel — a vast living intestinal labyrinth beneath the city that digests collective human embarrassment into a neutralized slurry — to retrieve a bureaucratic seal accidentally flushed during a toilet-related workplace accident. Dagne wants the seal to cover her ass (she caused the accident mid-anxiety-attack); Ruutu wants it because he genuinely believes the city will collapse without proper paperwork — and the mission is classified "Inverse Survivable" because the Underbowel feeds on suppressed shame, meaning every secret you're hiding manifests as a wet, anatomically explicit obstruction that smells exactly like your childhood bedroom. When they encounter a rival recovery team sent by a competing department and a territorial standoff erupts across a bridge of calcified regret, the Underbowel ruptures open a massive cyst containing a photo-realistic, three-story flesh sculpture of Dagne's boss performing the exact humiliating act that caused the flush in the first place — freezing every combatant in slack-jawed, reverent silence as Dagne's field report devolves into a single repeated profanity filling six consecutive pages.

narrative_beats:
# Seven Structural Beats for *Peristalsis*
### An Adapted Construction Blueprint

---

## Beat 1: The Incident Report Opens as Routine Bureaucracy

**What Happens:** Dagne files what appears to be a standard Municipal Shame-Processing Division incident report regarding a workplace accident involving a toilet, a bureaucratic seal, and the initiation of a retrieval mission classified "Inverse Survivable." The form fields are filled out with strained professionalism. The world — the Underbowel, shame-processing, the slurry, the job title — is established entirely through the language of compliance. Ruutu is introduced via a co-signee field or a noted team assignment. The tone is clipped, procedural, aggressively banal.

**Narrative Technique to Deploy:** *World-building through bureaucratic form as prose constraint.* The incident report format does the work that Le Guin's ekphrastic festival description does — it constructs a world detail by detail — but here the constraint of the *form itself* generates both information and comedy. Every field label ("Nature of Hazard," "Equipment Lost," "Emotional Liability Index") reveals something about the world while simultaneously strangling the human experience it's trying to contain. The reader learns that the city has a living intestinal labyrinth beneath it *not* through exposition but through a dropdown menu. The technique is *setting as bureaucracy* — the world exists because someone had to fill out paperwork about it. Stacking clause upon clause is replaced by stacking field upon field, checkbox upon checkbox, each one quietly unhinged.

**Why This Beat Must Work:** The same principle as Omelas's festival: *you must build the thing the reader invests in before you destroy it.* But here what the reader invests in is not beauty — it's *the illusion of institutional competence.* The comedy of this story depends on the forms starting out looking almost plausibly functional. The reader needs to believe, for at least one page, that this is a world where someone could file a report about a living intestinal shame-labyrinth and have it processed normally. The gap between the content (grotesque, impossible, visceral) and the container (beige, procedural, soul-deadening) is the engine of the entire story. If the forms start unhinged, there's nowhere to go. Start boring. Start proper. Let the reader feel the brittle competence of a woman holding everything together with Arial 11-point font and a checkbox marked "No" next to "Was the incident preventable?"

---

## Beat 2: The Form Cracks — Dagne's Voice Bleeds Through the Margins

**What Happens:** A second document — perhaps a supplementary field narrative, an appended clarification, or an HR complaint form filed against herself — begins to strain against its own format. Dagne starts writing in the margins, or the "Additional Comments" field metastasizes to three times the length of the rest of the form. Professional language curdles into something confessional. We learn that Dagne *caused* the accident. Mid-anxiety-attack. On the toilet. The seal was in her hand because she'd been holding it for reasons she cannot yet bring herself to articulate in a government document. She tries to maintain third person. She fails. First person erupts like a puncture. "I was not — the undersigned was not — I wasn't even supposed to be in that stall."

**Narrative Technique to Deploy:** *Metaformal rupture — the document acknowledging it cannot contain its own content.* This mirrors Le Guin's fourth-wall break where the narrator confesses that Omelas "sounds like a fairy tale." Dagne's version is: *this form cannot hold what actually happened to me.* The HR complaint format becomes a site of epistemological crisis — the boxes demand categorization ("Type of Grievance: Physical / Emotional / Metaphysical / Gastrointestinal") but the experience resists every category. The technique is the comedic weaponization of formal inadequacy. Each time Dagne tries to wrestle her experience back into professional language and fails, the failure itself tells the story. The form is the narrator struggling to narrate.

**Why This Beat Must Work:** This is where the reader shifts from *observing a world* to *hearing a person.* Le Guin needed the reader to confront their own distrust of happiness; you need the reader to confront their recognition of Dagne's specific, humiliating, deeply relatable panic — the terror of having caused the very disaster you're writing the report about. The comedy must land, but underneath it, Dagne's anxiety must register as *real.* The beat inoculates against the story reading as pure absurdist gag by establishing genuine emotional stakes inside the ridiculous format. Dagne isn't a comic figure. She's a woman who had an anxiety attack on a toilet and lost a government seal into a living intestine beneath her city, and she is trying to describe this using a form designed for slip-and-fall incidents. The reader's laughter should catch in their throat at least once.

---

## Beat 3: The Accidental Voice-to-Text to Mom — The Reader Becomes the Wrong Audience

**What Happens:** The first voice-to-text message appears — sent to "Mom (DO NOT REPLY)" instead of whoever Dagne meant to contact. It's mid-descent into the Underbowel. The message is fragmented, panicked, full of autocorrect disasters that transform shame-processing jargon into something obscene or nonsensical. Through the broken transcription, we get the first *sensory* experience of the Underbowel — the sound, the warmth, the wetness, the smell ("it smells like my room, Mom, it smells like my room when I was twelve and I don't want to talk about why"). Ruutu is heard in the background, probably saying something earnest about municipal infrastructure. Dagne is clearly talking to herself about him, not realizing the phone is transcribing. We learn about Ruutu's sincere belief that paperwork holds civilization together. We learn about Dagne's opinion of this belief. Mom receives all of it.

**Narrative Technique to Deploy:** *Involuntary intimacy as complicity mechanism.* This is the structural equivalent of Le Guin inviting the reader to co-build Omelas. In Le Guin's version, you become complicit by *choosing* to add details to the city. Here, the reader becomes complicit by *receiving a confession never meant for them.* The voice-to-text format does three things simultaneously: (1) it provides raw, unfiltered interiority that the forms suppress, (2) it generates comedy through transcription errors and the horror of a mother receiving this, and (3) it makes the reader an eavesdropper — structurally identical to the mother, consuming something private, unable to intervene. The reader is not co-authoring Omelas; the reader is *Dagne's mother, holding the phone, reading in real time, helpless.* Complicity through accidental receipt. You didn't ask to know these things. You can't unknow them.

**Why This Beat Must Work:** The three document types (incident reports, HR forms, voice-to-texts) are not interchangeable containers — they are *registers of increasingly demolished composure.* The incident report is Dagne-as-professional. The HR form is Dagne-as-employee-barely-coping. The voice-to-text is Dagne-as-human-animal. This beat must establish the voice-to-text as the story's id — the channel where everything the forms are trying to contain comes spilling out in unformatted, autocorrected, desperate bursts. It also establishes the emotional architecture: Dagne talking to her mother (accidentally) means the reader occupies the position of the person Dagne most needs and most fears being seen by. Every subsequent voice-to-text will escalate this tension. The reader must feel, by the end, that they are holding something they were never supposed to see.

---

## Beat 4: The Underbowel Feeds — Shame Manifests as Obstruction

**What Happens:** The retrieval mission hits its first major obstacle. The Underbowel, which feeds on suppressed shame, begins generating obstructions from Dagne's and Ruutu's hidden embarrassments. Dagne's incident report attempts to describe these clinically ("Obstruction 4-C: tissue-like formation, approx. 2m x 1.5m, morphologically consistent with — ") but the description keeps collapsing because the obstructions are *too specific.* They are anatomically explicit. They are *recognizable.* One of them is shaped like something from Dagne's adolescence. Another smells like Ruutu's — something. He won't say. The field report's clinical language is now doing desperate, visible labor to contain material that cannot be contained. A voice-to-text to Mom devolves into "don't open this don't open this I didn't send this."

**Narrative Technique to Deploy:** *Tonal rupture through the collision of clinical language and visceral, painfully specific grotesquerie.* This mirrors Le Guin's shift from baroque festival prose to the flat, blunt description of the child. But here the rupture runs in *both directions simultaneously*: the bureaucratic flatness is trying to describe something baroque and obscene, and the obscene content keeps puncturing the bureaucratic flatness. Le Guin used *strategic ugliness* — sparse sentences against lush ones. Here, deploy *strategic specificity against strategic euphemism* — the reports trying to use terms like "tissue formation" and "olfactory trigger" while the voice-to-texts are screaming about what the thing actually looks like. The prose style of each document type enacts a different stage of psychological defense in the face of the same horror.

**Why This Beat Must Work:** This is your Child in the Basement. Not morally — this isn't about innocent suffering — but *structurally.* This is the hinge where the story's metaphor becomes literal and inescapable. The conceit that the Underbowel "feeds on suppressed shame" has been stated; now it must be *experienced.* The reader must feel, physically, the particular nausea of having a private shame made spatially real, enormous, and *obstinate* — a thing you have to climb over or squeeze past while it smells like your childhood bedroom. The comedy and the horror must be indistinguishable. "Please let me out. I will be good" becomes the thing Dagne cannot say in any of her forms: *I am ashamed, and the city's digestive system knows it.* The obstructions should be specific enough to make the reader involuntarily think of their *own* suppressions. The Underbowel must become briefly, terribly universal.

---

## Beat 5: The Rival Team and the Bridge of Calcified Regret — The System Has Competing Interests

**What Happens:** Dagne and Ruutu encounter the rival recovery team sent by a competing department. A territorial standoff erupts on a bridge made of calcified regret (the Underbowel's geological record of the city's accumulated, unprocessed remorse). The rival team has their own paperwork, their own authorization, their own claim to the seal. Dagne's incident report suddenly shifts into the language of jurisdictional dispute — citing regulation numbers, departmental precedents, chain-of-custody protocols. But the bridge beneath them is *literal regret* — it groans, it shifts, it whispers. The two bureaucratic claims are being adjudicated on a surface made of everything the city could never bring itself to process. Both teams insist the seal belongs to their chain of command. Neither team can explain *why the seal matters so much* without admitting something institutional — something about what the seal authorized, what it covered, what it allowed to remain unfiled.

**Narrative Technique to Deploy:** *The terms of the bargain delivered as bureaucratic turf war over a literal intestinal territory.* Le Guin presented Omelas's bargain as cosmological law — immutable, mechanistic, beyond negotiation. Here, the bargain is the same (the city functions because shame is processed and suppressed; the paperwork is what keeps the suppression organized) but it is revealed through *competing institutional claims to own the suppression mechanism.* The seal is not just a bureaucratic tool — it is the instrument that makes the Underbowel's function *official.* Without it, the shame-processing is unauthorized. Unregulated. The standoff makes visible what was implicit: *the city's relationship to its own shame is not natural; it is administered.* The rival team's existence reveals that the system has redundancies, rival claims, internal politics — it is maintained not by cosmic law but by *people filing forms about it.* This is your Le Guinian mirror: the bargain isn't metaphysics; it's middle management.

**Why This Beat Must Work:** Le Guin's bargain is memorable because there's no villain, no mechanism, no one to blame. Here, the mechanism is *visible and absurd* — it's departments fighting over who has the right to manage the city's digestive shame-tract — and that visibility is what makes it damning. The comedy of two bureaucratic teams having a jurisdictional standoff inside a living intestine, standing on calcified regret, arguing about authorization codes, should be simultaneously the funniest

# PERISTALSIS

## MUNICIPAL SHAME-PROCESSING DIVISION
### Incident Report — Form 11-C (Standard Workplace Event, Non-Fatal)

---

**Report No.:** SPD-2024-0functory-4471

**Date of Incident:** 14 Güldenmarch, Year of the Adequate Sewer

**Time of Incident:** Approx. 09:14 Municipal Standard (pre-coffee, post-first-sigh)

**Filing Officer:** Dagne Klaedirsdottír, Junior Shame-Processing Technician (Grade 4, Provisional)

**Co-Signee / Assigned Recovery Partner:** Ruutu Pappinen, Senior Infrastructural Compliance Auditor (Grade 6, Permanent, God Help Him)

**Location of Incident:** Sub-Level 4 Comfort Facility, Stall 3 (the one with the loose seat — see also: Maintenance Request 2023-1187, 2023-1204, 2023-1340, 2024-0022, 2024-0313, and the handwritten note taped to the door reading "AGAIN???" which to my knowledge has never been formally attributed)

---

**SECTION A: NATURE OF EVENT**

**Category of Incident:**
☐ Slip / Trip / Fall
☐ Chemical Exposure (Emotional)
☐ Chemical Exposure (Physical)
☐ Chemical Exposure (Atmospheric — Shame Vapour Class II or Above)
☒ Equipment Loss into Active Slurry Channel
☐ Spontaneous Structural Dissolution
☐ Encounter with Unnamed
☐ Other: ___________

**Sub-Category (if Equipment Loss):**
☒ Bureaucratic Instrument (Seal, Stamp, Notarizing Implement)
☐ Protective Equipment (Gloves, Apron, Dignity)
☐ Personnel

**Equipment Lost:**
One (1) Divisional Authorization Seal, Class 9 ("The Big One"), brass-and-bone composite, engraved with the Municipal Shame-Processing Division motto (*Quod Supprimiur, Processimus* — "That Which Is Suppressed, We Process"), last serviced 12 Grim, Year of the Clogged Tributary. Noted identifying feature: small chip on lower left quadrant from when Alderman Fisker used it to open a bottle of porter at the 2022 Interdepartmental Solstice Function (see: HR File #SOLST-2022-09, "Re: Inappropriate Use of Divisional Instruments, Alcoholic").

**Estimated Replacement Value:** ██████.██ (see Finance Appendix 7-A; note that Finance has not returned our copy of Finance Appendix 7-A since the Amalgamation of 2019 and responds to requests for it with an automated reply reading "Your inquiry is important to us.")

---

**SECTION B: ENVIRONMENTAL CONDITIONS AT TIME OF INCIDENT**

**Slurry Activity Level:**
☐ Dormant
☐ Low Motility
☒ Standard Peristaltic
☐ Elevated Peristaltic
☐ Active Churn
☐ "Don't Go In There"

**Underbowel Status (per Morning Bioacoustic Reading):**
☒ Within functional parameters. Gurgling registered at 44 dB (ambient). No contractions logged above Tolerance Threshold 6. Shame-absorption index: nominal. Mucosa condition: glistening. (Note: these readings are taken daily by Sub-Level Monitoring and have been taken daily by Sub-Level Monitoring for forty-seven years and have never once, in forty-seven years, predicted anything useful, but the readings continue because the form has a field for them and the form has a field for them because someone once created the form and the person who created the form retired in 1998 and no one has the admin credentials to modify it.)

**Ambient Emotional Residue:**
☐ Negligible
☒ Mild generalized unease
☐ Acute localized dread
☐ Historical (pre-municipal)
☐ Unsourced

---

**SECTION C: IMMEDIATE RESPONSE**

**Was the Divisional Emergency Protocol engaged?**
☒ Yes

**Which protocol?**
Retrieval Protocol 7-Ω: "Inverse Survivable" — the deployment of a two-person team into the Upper Underbowel for the recovery of critical divisional materiel under conditions expected to be survivable in the inverse sense: i.e., survival is the outcome that requires explanation.

**Retrieval Team Composition:**
1. Dagne Klaedirsdottír (see above)
2. Ruutu Pappinen (see above; see also Appendix D, "Why Pappinen," which is empty because no one has ever satisfactorily answered this question but he is always assigned regardless because he owns waterproof boots and has, quote, "the demeanor for it")

**Was the incident preventable?**
☐ Yes
☒ No
☐ Theoretically
☐ In hindsight, which is not a recognized temporal jurisdiction of this Division

---

**SECTION D: ADDITIONAL NOTES**

Standard retrieval provisions were requisitioned: two headlamps (one functioning), one departmental descent harness (fits no human body), four meters of guide-rope (frayed, previously condemned, returned to active inventory by someone whose name has been redacted from the equipment log with what appears to be correction fluid and a thumbprint), nutritional rations (expired; expiry pre-dates current municipal calendar system), and one copy of the Shame-Processing Division Field Manual, 14th Edition, which has a chapter on Underbowel navigation that consists of a single page reading: "Proceed with conviction. If conviction is unavailable, proceed anyway."

Descent initiated 09:47. Communication expected to be intermittent due to known signal attenuation properties of processed shame deposits at depth.

This report is filed in compliance with Municipal Ordinance 7.4.12(b) and not because I want to be filing it. I do not want to be filing it. The form does not have a field for whether the filing officer wants to be filing it. If it did, the answer would be a drawing of a woman lying face-down on the floor.

—Dagne Klaedirsdottír
Junior Shame-Processing Technician (Grade 4, Provisional, Descending)

## MUNICIPAL SHAME-PROCESSING DIVISION
### Supplementary Narrative Field — Form 11-C-Supp.
### (For Use When Standard Form Fields Prove "Insufficient to Capture the Event Under Report")

---

**Appended to Incident Report:** SPD-2024-04471

**Filed by:** Dagne Klaedirsdottír

**Reason for Supplementary Filing:**
☐ Standard fields insufficient (spatial)
☐ Standard fields insufficient (categorical)
☒ Standard fields insufficient (ontological)
☐ Filer was instructed to "just write it up normal, Dagne, please"

---

**SUPPLEMENTARY NARRATIVE:**

The undersigned wishes to clarify, for the record, and exclusively for the record, certain details regarding the precipitating event which the standard form's field structure did not accommodate with the precision that — which the undersigned believes — which I believe—

The undersigned will attempt numbered points.

**1.** The seal was in the undersigned's possession at the time of the incident because the undersigned had removed it from the Division's Secure Instrument Cabinet (SIC) at approximately 08:50 in order to notarize a stack of backlogged shame-processing clearance certificates (Form 23-F, "Certification of Adequate Suppression") that had been accumulating on the undersigned's desk since the previous Wednesday because the undersigned could not bring herself to notarize them because every time the undersigned pressed the seal to paper the seal made a sound like a small animal exhaling and the undersigned found this — the undersigned is aware this is not a recognized equipment complaint category — the undersigned found this *uncomfortable.*

**2.** Rather than process the certificates at her desk, the undersigned brought the seal with her when she left her workstation at 09:08 because she was carrying it in her hand because she was going to process the certificates immediately after using the comfort facility because she told herself she was going to process them immediately after but she was not going to process them immediately after. She was going to sit in the stall and breathe. She was going to count her breaths. She had read an article about this. The article was from a newsletter called *Coping Within the Municipality: Strategies for the Publicly Employed* and it said to count to four on the inhale and to seven on the exhale and it did not say what to do when you are on your third inhale and your hand spasms and you drop a Class 9 Divisional Authorization Seal directly into an active slurry channel via a municipal toilet that connects, as all toilets on Sub-Level 4 connect, to the upper Underbowel's intake membrane, and the seal makes the same small animal exhale sound as it disappears through the mucal valve, and the sound is worse this time, and you are sitting there with your hand still open over the bowl and your lungs somewhere in the middle of the count, five, maybe, and the article did not cover five.

**3.** The undersigned experienced, at this time, what the Municipal Health Services pamphlet HR-Wellness-2019-04 describes as "an acute autonomic stress response in the workplace" and what the undersigned would describe, with respect, as the moment when the floor of your life drops out and you can hear it hit slurry on the way down.

**4.** The undersigned reported the loss immediately. This is not accurate. The undersigned sat in the stall for four minutes. During this time period the undersigned did not move. The undersigned did not breathe according to any recognized pattern. The undersigned stared at the bowl, which was now quiescent, which was worse than if it had been active, because a quiescent bowl after a loss event is a bowl that has *accepted* what it has been given, and this — the undersigned is veering. The undersigned will return to numbered points.

**5.** The undersigned reported the loss at 09:17 to Floor Supervisor Helskitt, who said, and I am quoting this directly because I will never forget it, "Oh, *Dagne.*" Not angry. Tired. The way you say someone's name when they have confirmed something you suspected about them a long time ago. The way my mo — the way a person says a name when the name has become a shorthand for a kind of failure they've stopped being surprised by.

**6.** Retrieval Protocol 7-Ω was initiated. Ruutu Pappinen was assigned. Of course Ruutu Pappinen was assigned. Ruutu Pappinen is always assigned. Ruutu Pappinen has waterproof boots. Ruutu Pappinen has a laminated checklist. Ruutu Pappinen has never, to my knowledge, dropped anything into anything because Ruutu Pappinen's hands do not spasm because Ruutu Pappinen does not lie awake at night wondering whether the sound the seal makes is actually an exhalation or if the seal is just brass-and-bone and she is projecting onto municipal equipment because she cannot stop projecting onto things because she has been doing this, this projecting, this flinching at mundane objects, this hearing of exhalations where there are no lungs, for so long that she cannot —

**7.** The undersigned retracts point 6. The undersigned does not know whether Ruutu Pappinen lies awake at night. The undersigned has no data on Ruutu Pappinen's nocturnal state. The form does not ask about Ruutu Pappinen's nocturnal state. If it did, the undersigned would leave it blank. The undersigned would leave it very deliberately blank.

I was not — the undersigned was not — I wasn't even supposed to be in that stall. I always use Stall 1. Stall 1 has a functioning lock and a distance from the intake membrane that Maintenance has described as "probably fine." I was in Stall 3 because Stall 1 was occupied and I could not wait because I had the seal in my hand and my hand was already shaking and if I had gone back to my desk I would have sat there holding the seal for another four hours and the certificates would not have been notarized and Floor Supervisor Helskitt would have said my name again in that voice, that "Oh, Dagne" voice, and I would rather drop the seal into the literal digestive system of the city than hear that voice again, which, apparently, is exactly the choice the universe offered me, and I chose, and here we are.

This concludes the supplementary narrative. The undersigned is aware it has exceeded the recommended length for Form 11-C-Supp by a factor of approximately nine. The undersigned notes that the form's recommended length field reads "Keep to the facts; 250 words should suffice," and the undersigned would like to enter into the record that 250 words have never once sufficed for anything, least of all facts, and that the person who designed this form has never had to describe losing a Class 9 seal through a mucal valve while in the middle of an acute autonomic stress response in the one stall on Sub-Level 4 that everybody knows not to use, and the undersigned would like a different form, and there is no different form, and this is the form, and I am done with it.

—D.K.

---

**ADMINISTRATIVE NOTE (affixed post-filing by Records):** Supplementary narrative received. Length noted. Forwarded to HR for review per Standard Overshare Protocol. Filer's request for "a different form" has been logged and will be addressed at the next Forms Governance Committee meeting (currently scheduled: NEVER — see Committee Dissolution Notice 2017-03, "Re: The Forms Governance Committee Has Been Dissolved Due to an Inability to Agree on the Form Required to Dissolve It.")

Write a story where Spike Spiegel (Cowboy Bebop) and Revy (Black Lagoon) meet in a seedy bar after both being hired for the same bounty.
